subject: planner: fix index merge skyline pruning may be prior to choose distinct partial index rather than the low count one. (#61372)
summary: Reviewed `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go` change to `matchPropForIndexMergeAlternatives`: it now picks the lowest-rowcount matching alternative per OR-branch (no forced distinct-index selection), and only rejects all-single-index IndexMerge when there are no IndexMerge hints and no MV index. No Blocker/High correctness/semantic issues found; upstream/master retains the same approach.
